# Before We Leave Archipelago Mod - v0.1.1
 
This is a bug fix update fixing critical issues that were found with the initial release
 
## What's Changed
 
 - Progressive Housing unlock path changed from:
| Progressive Housing | House → School → Apartment | to →
| Progressive Housing | School → House → Apartment |
- **Save/load persistence** — a json file is created along with a save allowing 
  AP unlocks to stay consistent between sessions.
- **Unlock Order** — added some rules to the apworld to help avoid getting stuck
(note: there is still a potential that there are some missing rules so if you find one let me know)


## Known Issues
- **Connection UI** — if accidentally pressed play offline, there is no way to reopen the 
  Archipelago connection UI requiring a restart.
- **Quit button UI** — the Archipelago connection screen does not fully
  dismiss when the quit button fade animation plays. It disappears when
  the game closes.
- **Win conditions** — win conditions are implemented but have not been fully tested.
- **Debug logging** — the log output is verbose and includes diagnostic
  information that will be cleaned up in a future release.
- **Repair** — after researching the repair node, the repair functionality 
  is available even if you haven't received it from AP yet.

## Requirements
 
- Before We Leave (Steam)
- BepInEx 5.4.x (x64 Unity)
- Archipelago 0.6.7 or later
## Installation
 
See [README.md](README.md) for full installation instructions.
v0.1.title: Before We Leave Archipelago Mod - v0.1.1

# Before We Leave Archipelago Mod - v0.1.0 Initial Release
 
This is the first public release of the Before We Leave Archipelago mod, bringing
multiworld randomizer support to Before We Leave via the Archipelago framework.
 
## What's Included
 
### Core Features
 
- **Technology randomization** — all researchable technologies are shuffled into
  the Archipelago item pool. Research technologies in the library to send location
  checks, and receive randomized technology unlocks from the multiworld.
- **Progressive technology chains** — nine technology groups are organized into
  progressive chains so you can never receive a high-level technology before its
  prerequisites. For example, Progressive Mining always grants Mining before
  Metalwork, Glass, and Laser in that order.
- **In-game connection UI** — connect to your Archipelago server directly from
  the main menu without editing any config files. Your connection details are
  saved automatically for future sessions.
- **Offline play** — the Play Offline button on the connection screen lets you
  play the game normally without connecting to an Archipelago server.
### Progressive Technology Groups
 
| Group | Technologies |
|-------|-------------|
| Progressive Housing | House → School → Apartment |
| Progressive Mining | Mining → Metalwork → Glass → Laser |
| Progressive Elevator | Elevator → SpaceElevator |
| Progressive Power | Repair → Power → OilPower → CleanPower |
| Progressive Happiness | Pump → Music → MeetingSquare → RoadDecoration |
| Progressive Food | Gardening → Cooking → Farming → Baking |
| Progressive Upgrades | Tinkering → Automation → Filtering |
| Progressive Rocket | Fuel → Space |
| Progressive Shipping | Shipping → AdvancedShipping → Airships |
 
### Win Conditions
 
Three win conditions are available via your player YAML:
 
- **Launch Rocket** *(default)* — launch your first rocket. Short game.
- **Colonize Planets** — colonize 2 to 7 planets. Medium game.
- **Complete Game** — See the end game scene. Long game.
## Known Issues
 
- **Save/load persistence** — researched and granted technologies are stored
  in memory only and will reset when the game is closed. Archipelago will
  replay all received items on reconnect so grants are recovered, but the
  checkmark display for researched technologies will be lost. This will be
  addressed in a future release.
- **Quit button UI** — the Archipelago connection screen does not fully
  dismiss when the quit button fade animation plays. It disappears when
  the game closes.
- **Connection UI** — if accidentally pressed play offline, there is no way to reopen the 
  Archipelago connection UI requiring a restart.
- **Repair** — repair functionality doesn't work properly if received before researching 
  the item in the library
- **Win conditions** — win conditions are implemented but have not been fully tested.
- **Debug logging** — the log output is verbose and includes diagnostic
  information that will be cleaned up in a future release.
## Requirements
 
- Before We Leave (Steam)
- BepInEx 5.4.x (x64 Unity)
- Archipelago 0.6.7 or later
## Installation
 
See [README.md](README.md) for full installation instructions.
